newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - U.S. Filter deal positive.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - U.S. Filter deal positive.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co analyst Jeffrey Robins said U.S. Filter Corp's plan to move in the $90 billion residential water treatment market marks a positive long-term development.

-- U.S. Filter said Friday it agreed to buy Iowa-based U.S. Water Co, which provides water softening products and services and drinking water treatment products. Terms of the deal were not disclosed. U.S. Water posted 1996 revenues of more than $22 million.
-- Gruntal said it continues to recommend purchase of U.S. Filter shares and set a 12-month price target of $48 a share.
-- Gruntal expects U.S. Filter to earn $0.80 a share for the year ended March 1997, $1.32 a share for the 1998 fiscal year and $1.80 a share for the 1999 fiscal year.
-- U.S. Filter lost 3/4 to 33-1/8 at midday with 3.7 million shares exchanging hands, making it one of the most heavily-traded stocks on the New York Stock Exchange.
